errors.what: Input gear1 (small orange) turns far too slowly. It advances only about 30 deg/s, reaching roughly 100 deg by t=3.67s, instead of 90 deg/s (one revolution in 4 s). The whole train (gear2, gear3, gear4) is therefore slowed by the same factor. Gear4 reaches only about 15 deg by t=3.67s versus the expected ~55 deg. The gear2 and gear4 reference lines also show no full revolution of the input over the 12 frames. The directions of rotation and the ratios between gears look right.
